explication: Agent Router is an Envoy-powered control plane and data plane for OpenAI-compatible AI and agent traffic. Kubernetes administrators define routes, backends, security, quotas, and MCP resources; the controller reconciles them into Envoy Gateway and external-processor configuration. Client requests then pass through Envoy to endpoint-specific processors, which authenticate, translate, mutate, meter, and route traffic to hosted or self-hosted providers. MCP traffic follows a separate proxy path. Standalone CLI operation is also supported. The tree and excerpts show wiring boundaries, but not every unsampled controller or translator call.
